claims: Billy Bush (William Hall Bush) is an American radio and television host.
Billy Bush was a correspondent and anchor for Access Hollywood from 2001 to 2016.
Billy Bush was a co-host of NBC’s Today show.
Billy Bush is a member of the Bush political family.
Billy Bush is the nephew of President George H.W. Bush.
Billy Bush is the cousin of President George W. Bush.
Billy Bush was the primary anchor for Access Hollywood.
Billy Bush joined Today after Access Hollywood.
In 2016, Billy Bush was fired from Today.
Billy Bush was fired from Today following the release of a 2005 Access Hollywood tape.
On a 2005 Access Hollywood tape, Billy Bush was heard engaging in lewd conversation with Donald Trump.
Billy Bush was born to Josephine Colwell Bush and Jonathan Bush.
Before Access Hollywood, Billy Bush hosted Billy Bush and The Bush League Morning Show on WWZZ-FM in Washington, D.C.
Billy Bush hosted the Miss Universe pageant.
Billy Bush served as a correspondent for multiple Olympics.
After the 2016 tape scandal, Billy Bush returned to television as the host of Extra in 2019.
There have been interviews in 2025/2026 where Billy Bush reflected on his career and the 2005 tape scandal.
